note: River level gauges in the Republic of Ireland with the exceedance percentiles waterlevel.ie publishes for them. wet/mid/dry are Percentile-05, -50 and -95: the level exceeded 5 per cent of the time, half the time, and 95 per cent of the time. THEY RUN DOWNWARDS — wet > mid > dry — because a level exceeded 95 per cent of the time is a LOW river. Values are absolute levels above Malin Head datum, not a stage above a local zero, so they read 8 to 111 metres and cannot be compared with an English gauge's number.
